spans.s:
m. (-कः)
1 An owl.
2 The root of an elephant's tail.
3 The tip of it.
4 A cloud.
5 A bed.
6 A louse.
E.
पच to spread, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, इट् inserted.

m. (-की)
An elephant.
E.
पेचक the root of an elephant's tail, इनि aff.

m. (-लः)
An elephant.
E.
पेच for पेचक as above, इलच् aff.

m. (-चुः)
An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
E.
पिच to hurt, उ aff.; also with उलट् aff. पेचुल, fem. पेचुली.

f. (-ली)
An esculent root: see the last.
